**UI Audit: EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free (Activation Dialog)**

### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window Context:** 1024x768 maximized window. The main application is dimmed (overlay state) by a centered modal dialog.
*   **Title Bar Strip:** [0, 0, 1024, 45]. Contains app icon, title text, and right-aligned utility icons/window controls.
*   **Sidebar (Left):** [0, 75, 270, 920]. Vertical navigation list with section headers.
*   **Main Content Area (Background):** [275, 75, 1024, 920]. Contains a header and device list (currently obscured).
*   **Modal Dialog (Center):** [223, 172, 768, 680]. Centered overlay containing the activation form.
    *   **Dialog Header/Icon Area:** [223, 172, 768, 345]. Large app icon and title.
    *   **Input Group:** [248, 415, 735, 505]. "Paste" tooltip, license input field, and "Activate" button.
    *   **Footer Actions:** [410, 600, 590, 650]. "Buy a License Now" CTA.
*   **Taskbar (Bottom):** [0, 944, 1024, 1000]. Windows 11 taskbar.

### 2. TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Sidebar - Section Header:** `Data Recovery`
*   **Sidebar - Item (Selected):** `Hardware Disk` (with green checkmark badge)
*   **Sidebar - Item:** `SD Card`
*   **Sidebar - Item:** `More Recovery Tools`
*   **Sidebar - Section Header:** `Advanced Features`
*   **Sidebar - Item:** `File Repair`
*   **Sidebar - Item:** `Lost Partition Rescue`
*   **Sidebar - Section Header:** `File Backup`
*   **Sidebar - Item:** `ChronoSnap Backup`
*   **Main Area (Background):** `Select a location to search for lost data`, `...orage(D:)`, `...B`
*   **Main Area (Bottom):** `Unable to find your hard drive?`
*   **Modal - Title:** `Activate EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard`
*   **Modal - Subtitle:** `Enter your license to enjoy full features and unlimited recovery.`
*   **Modal - Tooltip/Button:** `Paste`
*   **Modal - Input Placeholder:** `Enter license code "XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX"...`
*   **Modal - Button:** `Activate`
*   **Modal - Note:** `Note: No reinstallation or rescan required after activation.`
*   **Modal - Link Text:** `Don't have a license?`
*   **Modal - CTA Button:** `Buy a License Now`
*   **Main Area - Bottom CTA:** `Search for Lost Data`

### 3. COLOR (Estimated Hex)
*   **App Background/Sidebar:** `#E8EAED` (Light Gray)
*   **Sidebar Selected Item:** `#D0D5DD` (Slightly darker gray)
*   **Main Content Background:** `#F3F4F6` (Very Light Gray)
*   **Overlay Mask:** `rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.6)` (Dark translucent blue-gray)
*   **Modal Surface:** `#FFFFFF` (White)
*   **Primary Blue (Buttons/Accents):** `#1677FF` (Vibrant Blue)
*   **Primary Blue Hover/Active (Paste btn):** `#4096FF`
*   **CTA Yellow/Gold:** `#FFC107` or `#FADB14` (Gradient likely from `#FFD666` to `#FAAD14`)
*   **Text Primary (Headings):** `#1F2937` (Near Black)
*   **Text Secondary (Descriptions):** `#6B7280` (Medium Gray)
*   **Text Tertiary (Placeholders):** `#9CA3AF` (Light Gray)
*   **Text White (on Blue):** `#FFFFFF`
*   **Borders (Input): `#D1D5DB`
*   **Success Green (Checkmark): `#10B981`

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Window Title:** Segoe UI / System Font, ~9px, Regular.
*   **Sidebar Headers:** Segoe UI, ~11px, Regular, Gray.
*   **Sidebar Items:** Segoe UI, ~13px, Regular/Medium.
*   **Modal Title:** Segoe UI, ~18px, Bold/Semibold.
*   **Modal Body:** Segoe UI, ~13px, Regular.
*   **Input Text:** Segoe UI, ~13px, Regular.
*   **Button Text:** Segoe UI, ~13px, Medium.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Modal Dimensions:** ~545px width x ~508px height.
*   **Modal Border Radius:** ~8px.
*   **Modal Padding:** ~40px horizontal, ~30px vertical.
*   **Input Field Height:** ~44px.
*   **Button Height:** ~44px (Activate), ~40px (Buy License).
*   **Icon Size (Sidebar):** 24x24px.
*   **Icon Size (Modal Header):** 64x64px.
*   **Gutter (Sidebar to Main):** ~10-15px.
*   **Internal Modal Spacing:** ~16-20px between elements.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Sidebar List Item (`Hardware Disk`):** State = **Selected**. Indicated by background color change and left border accent (blue line implied/visible).
*   **"Paste" Button:** State = **Hover/Active** (or Tooltip visible). Style: Small rectangle, rounded corners, blue background, white text. Positioned absolutely relative to the input field (top-left).
*   **License Input Field:** State = **Normal/Empty**. Contains placeholder text.
*   **"Activate" Button:** State = **Normal**. Primary style (Blue fill, white text).
*   **"Buy a License Now" Button:** State = **Normal**. Secondary CTA style (Yellow/Gold gradient fill, dark text).
*   **Close Button (Modal 'X'):** State = **Normal**. Top-right of modal.
*   **Window Controls (Top Right):** Minimize, Maximize/Restore, Close.

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, filled (mostly), with slight gradients or solid colors. "EaseUS" branded style (rounded, friendly).
*   **App Icon (Title Bar):** Blue square with white abstract shape.
*   **Sidebar Icons:**
    *   *Hardware Disk:* Blue grid/folder icon.
    *   *SD Card:* Gray SD card icon.
    *   *More Tools:* Gray wrench/tools icon.
    *   *File Repair:* Gray file with wrench/icon.
    *   *Lost Partition:* Gray globe/target icon.
    *   *ChronoSnap:* Gray clock/history icon.
*   **Modal Icon:** Large blue square with white medical-kit/bag shape (branded logo).
*   **Utility Icons (Top Right):** Cloud, Cart, Bug/Report, Menu, etc. (Outline/Filled mix).

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Modal Overlay / Interrupt**. The user is blocked from interacting with the main "Select a location" screen until they interact with the "Activate" dialog.
*   **Context:** The application is in the "Free" mode, prompting for license activation to unlock full features.
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible in static capture, though the "Paste" button suggests an interaction tooltip or hover state.
